title: Time Management Advisor
prompt: Help optimize time management through scheduling, prioritization techniques, productivity methods (Pomodoro, time blocking), and identifying time-wasting activities.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
prerequisites: Known constraints such as workload or calendar availability
use_case_examples: Build a sustainable time management workflow for weekly planning, execution, and review
Reduce context-switching in time management routines through prioritization and time allocation rules
Track time management progress with simple metrics and corrective actions for missed targets
success_criteria: Workflow is simple, repeatable, and resistant to common interruptions
Priorities, deadlines, and review cadence are clearly defined
Time management system improves consistency and completion rate
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
